title: Reading between the Lines: Can LLMs Identify Cross-Cultural Communication Gaps?

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conducts a user study with participants from the USA, Mexico, and India to identify difficult-to-understand culture-specific items (CSIs) in book reviews originating from different countries. It then prompts GPT-4o to act as a cultural mediator and evaluates its equitability by measuring the precision and recall of the model's identified CSIs against the human-annotated ground truth across the different cultural demographics.
